exposure: hormonal therapy after surgical excision of abdominal wall endometriomas
cohort: 20 women who underwent surgery for abdominal wall endometriosis, 90% of whom were multiparous, with a mean age of 30.6 years.
finding: There was no difference in the recurrence rate of abdominal wall endometriomas between women who did and did not receive hormonal therapy after surgical excision, but those who received hormonal therapy had less localized pain and discomfort at the scar site.
